summary: Naval argues OpenAI's conversion from nonprofit to fully private entity is self-dealing and unnecessary, and that the nonprofit portion should retain control while employees receive incentive packages separately — the current structure amounts to a 'shell game.'
quote: I just don't understand this conversion... it also looks like self-dealing, right? And yeah, they'll get an independent valuation, but we all know that game.

summary: Jason predicts OpenAI could lose the New York Times copyright lawsuit badly, potentially facing injunctions, and that a Napster-style settlement could force closed AI models to pay a large share of revenue to content holders — a structural threat to OpenAI's economics.
quote: I think this is all going to wind up like the Napster-Spotify case... there is a non-zero chance... that OpenAI is going to lose the New York Times lawsuit and they're going to lose it hard and there could be injunctions.
